name: Report death
duplicates: built inside Inspection — see inspection / health-record

notes.purpose: The verb sheet over a mixed selection, Death as the only unfilled tile.
rules: Mixed states (sows plus a gilt) share no cycle verb, so the Production strip is absent, not empty; the not-available line names what was ticked.
edge: A pig reported by someone else a minute ago still reads alive on this device (the race the roster catches).

notes.purpose: One pig: the header (pen, tag, vitals) is the review.

elements.name: Cause
elements.shows: Multi-picker over the one condition catalogue

states.shows: "Cause unknown" is selected; picking a cause clears it

elements.rule: The catalogue stays open: a pig can die of something never recorded.

rules: The footnote states the consequence a farmer can check tomorrow: her case ends with her.

notes.purpose: Nothing is committed here: the selection read as names before the first death.

elements.name: Roster rows
elements.shows: To report (pen-grouped, per-row remove) and the blocked section

states.shows: Tag row with a remove control; Start counts down with each removal
Listed under the reason with who and when, with her pen code

elements.rule: Writes nothing: Start enters the per-pig chain, Cancel costs nothing.

edge: A fat-finger selection of 40 pigs shows as 40 rows, which a count in the header would not.

notes.purpose: One sheet, three pigs in a chain, cause carried forward.

elements.name: Carry token
elements.shows: Under the Cause field from pig 2 on
elements.logic: Cause carries from the previous pig; the token lets her distrust it in one glance. Photos never carry.

elements.name: Skip and leave
elements.rule: Skip writes nothing and she stays alive (not the same as Cause unknown). Leaving early is legal: committed deaths stand and nothing was a draft.

notes.purpose: The walk after the deaths: rows disappear in place and counts re-derive.
rules: Open cases freeze under the death record, a pending cull recommendation closes, and no surface can select her again.
Her page outlives her: the terminal band leads (left the herd · died), history stays whole.
edge: The only way back is the deliberate mis-entry correction (remove as supersession); everything then re-derives again.

notes.purpose: The count sheet for a group row: count, shared cause and photos in one commit.

elements.name: Count
elements.shows: Header, stepper and button all show the same number
elements.logic: Pre-filled from the group tick's stepper (production: ticking an un-identified pig asks for the number at once) and moves together when stepped.

rules: Two causes inside one group are two records: two passes, one sheet each; no per-head fiction.
After commit the decrement lands in the pen sheet trail (was 40 · 3 deaths · 1 moved) and the feed total re-sums.
